People for Bikes Coyoacán, Tuesday ride to Los Dinamos

Mexico City, Mexico · Coyoacán (Oxtopulco) · Road

People for Bikes Coyoacán, Tuesday ride to Los Dinamos is a road group ride in Mexico City, Mexico. It rolls every other Tuesday at 6:00 am local time from People for Bikes Coyoacán.

Next ride Tue, Oct 6, 6:00 AM CST every other week — confirm which week with the host

For visitors

Starts before sunrise, so bring lights. About 20 riders are registered with the city for each edition.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the People for Bikes Coyoacán, Tuesday ride to Los Dinamos group ride

The south-side version of the shop’s Tuesday ride. It leaves the Coyoacán store for the forest road at Los Dinamos in Magdalena Contreras, south-west of the city.
